title: The Broken Bridge
story_text:
While walking home, Leo saw that a small bridge was broken.
He needed to cross the stream to get home.
He looked around and found a longer path.
It took more time, but it was safe.
Leo chose the safer way and reached home.

questions.hint: Read the first sentence of the story.
questions.feedback: Leo saw a broken bridge. The first sentence says he saw that a small bridge was broken.

questions.question_text: What did he need to do?
questions.hint: Read the second sentence of the story.
questions.feedback: Leo needed to cross the stream to get home.

questions.hint: Read the third sentence of the story.
questions.feedback: Leo found a longer path after looking around.

questions.question_text: Why did he choose the longer path?
questions.hint: Read the fourth sentence of the story.
questions.feedback: He chose the longer path because it was safe.

questions.hint: Think about why Leo used the longer path instead of the broken bridge.
questions.feedback: The lesson is to choose safety. Leo took more time but reached home safely.

title: The Quiet Answer
story_text:
In class, Mia knew the answer to a question.
But she felt shy and did not raise her hand.
Another student answered instead.
After class, Mia told the teacher she knew it.
The teacher encouraged her to try next time.

questions.hint: Read the first sentence of the story.
questions.feedback: Mia knew the answer to a question.

questions.hint: Read the second sentence of the story.
questions.feedback: Mia did not answer because she felt shy.

questions.hint: Read the third sentence of the story.
questions.feedback: Another student answered instead.

questions.hint: Read the last sentence of the story.
questions.feedback: The teacher encouraged Mia to try next time.

questions.hint: Think about what Mia needed to do even though she felt shy.
questions.feedback: The message is to be confident. Mia knew the answer, and her teacher encouraged her to try.

title: The Lost Wallet
story_text:

He returned it to the owner, who thanked him warmly.

questions.hint: Think about why Sam returned the wallet.
questions.feedback: The lesson is to be honest. Sam returned something that did not belong to him.

title: The Late Project
story_text:

questions.feedback: Her work was not her best because she rushed.

questions.hint: Think about what Anna learned after rushing her project.
questions.feedback: The lesson is to manage time better. Anna learned not to delay important work.
